_comment: Do NOT hand-edit. The skill auto-creates config.json on first run: `advise.py detect-server` (Tailscale scan) finds the server IP, then `advise.py init --user <name> --host <ip> --node <name>` writes it. The IP comes from the Tailscale scan, your lab usage guide, or the admin. config.json is gitignored so host/user never leak when this skill is open-sourced.
_comment_host_lan: OPTIONAL. A direct/LAN address for the same server (e.g. a wired link or your lab's internal network). If its SSH port answers, the engine uses it -- typically an order of magnitude faster than a VPN path; if not reachable, it silently falls back to `host`. Leave empty or omit if you only ever reach the server one way.
